title: Steamed fish with ginger and spring onions
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Cut the ginger and spring onions into fine strips.
Put the fish on a plate, top with half the ginger and steam in a steamer or on a rack over simmering water for 8–10 minutes; steam the pak choi for the last 4 minutes.
Put the remaining ginger and spring onions on the fish and drizzle with soy sauce.
Heat both oils, pour them sizzling over the fish and serve with coriander, pak choi and rice.
